// Create lookup table function
#let get-color-info(hex) = {
  for item in color-details {
    if item.color == hex {
      return item
    }
  }
  return (color: hex, name: "Unknown", cat: "unknown")
}

)

#let null-palettes = (
  "Suppressed & Null Values": ("#ebebeb", "#a4a4a4", "#e3e1d3")
)

// Helper function to display color swatch with text below, constrained to square width
#let color-swatch-with-text(hex, square-size: 40pt) = {
  let info = get-color-info(hex)
  
  stack(
    dir: ttb,  // Changed from ltr to ttb for vertical stacking
    spacing: 4pt,
    // Square at specified size
    square(size: square-size, fill: rgb(hex)),
    // Text container constrained to same width
    block(
      width: square-size,
      inset: (x: 0pt, y: 2pt),
      text(
        size: 7pt,
        align(center, [
          #info.name
        ])
      )
    ),
    // Hex code in gray, also constrained
    block(
      width: square-size,
      text(
        size: 6pt,
        fill: gray,
        align(center, [
          #hex
        ])
      )
    )
  )
}

// Display all palettes
#heading(level: 2)[Categorical Palettes]
#for (name, colors) in categorical-palettes {
  heading(level: 3)[#name]
  grid(
    columns: (auto,) * colors.len(),
    gutter: 8pt,
    ..colors.map(hex => color-swatch-with-text(hex, square-size: 45pt))
  )
}
